title: Pael's Wing
description: You may sacrifice card rewards to Pael. Every 2 [blue]sacrifices[/blue], obtain a [gold]Relic[/gold].
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: This relic provides an alternative action during card reward selection: sacrifice the reward to obtain a relic instead. Every 2 sacrifices triggers a relic acquisition. The counter displays the current sacrifice count modulo the sacrifice threshold.
